Destined Rivals Booster Bundles fell 14.9% this week, from $65.23 to $55.54 TCGplayer market.

That's the biggest 7-day drop of any sealed product we track, and its lowest price since our data starts in April (peak: $86.37 in June). #PokemonTCG

Team Aqua's Kyogre EX (Double Crisis 6/34) has the lowest PSA 10 rate of any $150+ card we track.

6,443 graded by PSA. Only 11 tens: a 0.2% gem rate. 232 landed at PSA 9.

Raw: $704.60. PSA 9: $3,300. #PokemonTCG

A year ago, an OP-12 Legacy of the Master booster box was $104.22 TCGplayer market, below its $120 MSRP.

Today it's $289.84: up 178% in 12 months, about 2.4x MSRP. #OnePieceTCG

92 of the 150 sealed products we track are down over the past 4 weeks.

Hot take: the market is cooling, and it's hard for anything to hold momentum. No need to rush. Look for deals at 80–90% of market and on eBay auctions. #PokemonTCG #OnePieceTCG

Phantom Forces BB: $17,449 → $22,000 (+26%)
Fates Collide BB: $3,300 → $4,111 (+25%)
Team Up BB: $12,734 → $15,867 (+25%)

All XY or Sun & Moon era. #PokemonTCG
